lines.en: Our flight was delayed by three hours because of bad weather, so we missed our connection.
I am afraid my luggage has not arrived yet, although I was told it would be here this morning.
Could you tell me where I can file a complaint? The service on this flight was disappointing.
The hotel room was much smaller than it looked in the photos, and it had no sea view.
We missed the connecting train, so we had to wait four hours for the next one.
I lost my passport while I was walking around the old city, and I do not know what to do.
Is there any chance of getting a refund for the canceled tickets, or at least changing the date?
If we had left the hotel earlier, we would not have been stuck in traffic.
The taxi driver took a much longer route, and then he charged us double the normal price.
Despite all the problems we had on the way, we really enjoyed the trip.
